metadata.title: fix(ui): Admin UI "Select All" now respects search filters for tools/resources/prompts
metadata.author: bogdanmariusc10

## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #3950

---

## 📝 Summary

Fixed a bug in the Admin UI where the "Select All" button for tools, resources, and prompts was selecting ALL items in the system instead of respecting the active search filter.

**Problem:** When users searched for specific tools/resources/prompts and clicked "Select All", it would select every item in the database rather than just the filtered search results.

**Solution:**
- Added search query parameter `q` to three backend endpoints: `/admin/tools/ids`, `/admin/resources/ids` and `/admin/prompts/ids`
- Updated frontend JavaScript selectors to detect and pass the active search term to the backend
- Implemented case-insensitive search across multiple fields (ID, name, description, gateway name)
- Works in both "Add Server" and "Edit Server" modes

**Impact:** Users can now search for specific items and use "Select All" to select only the filtered results, providing the expected UX behavior.

## 📓 Notes

### Backend Changes (`mcpgateway/admin.py`):

- `/admin/tools/ids` endpoint (lines 8714-8761)
- `/admin/resources/ids` endpoint (lines 10058-10107)
- `/admin/prompts/ids` endpoint (lines 9973-10019)

### Frontend Changes (`mcpgateway/static/admin.js`):

- `initResourceSelect()` function (lines 10420-10423)
- `initPromptSelect()` function (lines 10851-10854)

### Tests Added (`tests/unit/mcpgateway/test_admin_ids_search.py`):

11 comprehensive unit tests covering:
- Search with query parameter
- Empty search query handling
- Search with gateway filter
- Search with team filter
- Search with no results
- Case-insensitive search
- Combined filters (search + gateway + team)

### Technical Details

The fix detects the appropriate search input element based on the context:

**Add Server mode:** Uses `#searchTools`, `#searchResources`, `#searchPrompts`
**Edit Server mode:** Uses `#searchEditTools`, `#searchEditResources`, `#searchEditPrompts`

Search is case-insensitive and uses the existing `_normalize_search_query()` and `_like_contains()` helper functions for consistency with other search implementations in the codebase.

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
Nice work on this fix, @bogdanmariusc10 — the core idea of wiring search queries into the Select All endpoints is solid.

During rebase I resolved a couple of conflicts and made some additional fixes worth calling out:

## Rebase changes

The monolithic `admin.js` was split into modules under `admin_ui/` in #3137, so I ported your frontend changes to `tools.js`, `resources.js`, and `prompts.js` using the correct search input element IDs from the modular codebase (`searchTools`/`searchEditTools`, etc.).

## Bugs fixed

1. **Duplicate `include_inactive` filter** — the prompts/ids and resources/ids endpoints each applied the `enabled.is_(True)` WHERE clause twice. Removed the duplicates.

2. **Prompt search field mismatch** — the prompt IDs endpoint was searching `DbPrompt.name`, but the HTML partial searches `original_name` and `display_name`. This would cause Select All to return different items than the visible filtered list. Updated to match.

3. **Team-scope divergence** — the IDs endpoints unconditionally included all platform-public items via a hardcoded `visibility == "public"` OR condition, but the visible list only includes them when the "View Public" checkbox is checked. Added an `include_public` query parameter (default `false`) to all three IDs endpoints, mirroring the partial endpoints. The frontend now reads the view-public checkbox and passes `include_public=true` when appropriate.

## Tests added

- 3 new Python tests for the `include_public` parameter
- 7 JS tests covering search param passing for add/edit modes across all three entity types
- Updated 3 existing regression tests (#3446) to pass `include_public=True`

## Verified

- All 14 Python unit tests pass
- All 166 JS unit tests pass
- E2E tested against a live deployment: search filtering, case insensitivity, team scoping, `include_public` toggle, backward compatibility, auth enforcement, and SQL injection resistance all confirmed working correctly.

commits.message:
fix(ui): port Select All search filter to modular JS, fix team-scope and search field bugs

- Port search query parameter passing from deleted monolithic admin.js to
  modular files: tools.js, resources.js, prompts.js in admin_ui/
- Remove duplicate include_inactive filter in prompt and resource IDs endpoints
- Fix prompt IDs endpoint search fields to match HTML partial (original_name,
  display_name instead of name) for consistent search results
- Add include_public parameter to all 3 IDs endpoints so Select All respects
  the "View Public" checkbox state, matching the visible filtered list in
  team-scoped mode
- Pass include_public from frontend Select All handlers by reading the
  view-public checkbox for both add and edit server modes
- Add JS unit tests for Select All search parameter passing in all 3 modules
- Add Python tests for include_public parameter

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
